Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

params.newOwners_: the array of addresses to add to _owners.

returns._1: the address of the treasury commission

getOwners().details: Returns a copy of the whole Set of owners.

returns._0: micropoolVoteRewardsPercentage the percentage of the rewards for the micropool voters
returns._1: treasuryVoteRewardsPercentage the percentage of the rewards for the treasury voters

params.oldOwners_: the array of addresses to remove from _owners

params.govCommission: the gov percentage commission. Should be multiplied by 10**25

params.micropoolVoteRewardsPercentage: the percentage of the rewards for the micropool voters
params.treasuryVoteRewardsPercentage: the percentage of the rewards for the treasury voters

addOwners(address[]).notice: Owner can add new owners to the contract's owners list.

getDEXECommissionPercentages().notice: The function to get commission percentage and receiver

getGovVotesLimit().notice: The function to get max votes limit of the gov pool

getInjector().notice: The function to get the current injector

getOwners().notice: Returns the addresses of the current owners.

getTokenSaleProposalCommissionPercentage.notice: The function to get the token sale proposal commission percentage

getVoteRewardsPercentages().notice: The function to get the vote rewards percentages

isOwner(address).notice: Returns true if address is in the contract's owners list.

removeOwners(address[]).notice: Owner can remove the array of owners from the contract's owners list.

renounceOwnership().notice: Allows to remove yourself from list of owners. Note: renouncing ownership may leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setDEXECommissionPercentages(uint128).notice: The function to modify the platform's commission percentages

setGovVotesLimit(uint128).notice: The function to set new gov votes limit

setInjector(address).notice: The function is made external to allow for the factories to set the injector to the ContractsRegistry

setTokenSaleProposalCommissionPercentage.notice: The function to set new token sale proposal commission percentage

setVoteRewardsPercentages(uint128,uint12.notice: The function to set new vote rewards percentages
